implementation: Readable C99 packed decimal quotient, integral truncation, finite product, cancellation-aware remainder and raw fallback policy; no CPU model or host floating point

implemented_routines.name: prepared quotient/remainder wrapper
implemented_routines.scope: Surd source preprocessing, ordinary marker/error admission, scalar conversion, eligible quotient/remainder export or ordinary-division plus raw70 fallback

implemented_routines.name: finite quotient/remainder eligibility
implemented_routines.scope: Original packed-prefix sign/exponent/distance gates, divide then integral truncation then product/subtraction order, cancellation suppression and remainder trailing-zero precision gate

implemented_routines.name: two ordinary scalar conversions
implemented_routines.scope: Unchanged decimal payloads, unchecked rational payload conversion after bit40 clearing, unsupported ordinary kinds normalized to F3

implemented_routines.name: two surd source conversions
implemented_routines.scope: Second operand then first operand surd-to-decimal replacement before ordinary admission; uses the separately verified finite component foundation

gaps: Parser token5F dispatch/precedence, terminalstatus37, expression cursor, result history and display are separate frontend/controller work
The API receives prepared value records; fetching rich matrix/vector references from a bank is separate work
Raw numerical helpers identify bounded native non-return domains with UNIMPLEMENTED and leave output untouched; this wrapper corpus contains only original returned calls
Malformed surd component payloads rejected by the finite component foundation remain explicitly UNIMPLEMENTED; valid prepared surds, including active-zero components, are verified
CPU registers, temporary pointers and unused native scratch bytes are not high-level result fields
